Shakespeare, 1564: The Baptism That Changed English

William Shakespeare, was born in Stratford-upon-Avon in 1564. Although there is no physical evidence confirming that he was born in house commonly recognised as his birthplace, records indicate that his parents had been living on Henley Street for over a decade prior to his birth. The house remained in family's possession until 1806, passing from Shakespeare’s daughter to his granddaughter, and subsequently to the descendants of his sister, Joan, which lends strong credibility to its heritage.
